title: X purges 13,000 accounts linked to suspected meddling ahead of US midterms
summary: X (formerly Twitter) has removed approximately 13,000 accounts suspected of coordinated manipulation and interference activities ahead of US midterm elections, representing one of the platform's largest enforcement actions against election-related manipulation.
problem_solved: Addresses coordinated inauthentic behavior and foreign interference attempts on social media platforms targeting democratic elections.
why_valuable: Demonstrates platform accountability in protecting electoral integrity and provides transparency about the scale of coordinated manipulation efforts.
